subject: Sponsor bridge: outcomes, risk matrix, and procurement checkpoints
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@medtechco.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@medtechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor bridge: outcomes, risk matrix, and procurement checkpoints

Hi Lisa / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re aligned with the executive sponsors before we loop in procurement.

What we heard (priority order):
- Business outcome: reduce clinical NLP inference latency for notes ingestion pipeline to sub-200ms p90 to enable near-real-time clinician decision support.
- Cost sensitivity: target a 40–50% reduction in per-token inference cost versus current on-prem baseline.
- Data controls: must satisfy in-scope auditability and key management requirements (SOC2 + customer-managed KMS).
- Risk concerns: impact to legacy EHR connectors, and procurement lead time for security/contract reviews.

Agreement / next steps we proposed on the call:
1) Redwood will produce an initial SOW + security checklist for sponsor review by Wed (attached draft SOW).
2) MedTech to confirm who the procurement and security reviewers are (name + email). Carlos — you mentioned procurement would likely request a standard vendor questionnaire and evidence.
3) We recommend a short technical readiness session with your platform lead (30–45 min) to validate EHR connector compatibility; target week of Apr 18.
4) Track decision: executive sponsor (CMO office) will confirm go/no-go for pilot by Apr 29.

Risks and mitigations (high level):
- Data flow risk: run a scoped, read-only pilot using synthetic/hashed records to validate latency without PHI.
- SLA/uptime: propose a canary + fallback model variant policy in the pilot to ensure continuity.

Attached: redwood_sow_draft_v1.pdf (draft scope) and a procurement timeline template. Please confirm procurement contacts and whether we can schedule the readiness session next week.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: redwood_sow_draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)]
[Attachment: procurement_timeline_medtech.xlsx (xlsx, 12 KB)]

From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@medtechco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@medtechco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medtechco.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor bridge: outcomes, risk matrix, and procurement checkpoints

Jonas —

Appreciate the concise summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Outcome priority confirmed by Dr. Patel (CMO office) — latency first, then cost.
- Procurement contact is Maria Alvarez (maria.alvarez@medtechco.com) — I’m looping her in. She’ll want SOC2 evidence and our standard security questionnaire answered.
- On the EHR connectors: our platform lead (Tony Rhee) can do the technical readiness session. Week of Apr 18 works; he prefers afternoons PST.

Risk note from security: they will not allow PHI in an external pilot. Synthetic records approach is mandatory — thanks for proposing that.

Next steps from MedTech: I will introduce Maria and Tony in a separate thread by EOD. Pulling legal in is likely after sponsor sign-off, so timeline you proposed looks reasonable.

LMK if you want a quick 15-minute touch before we introduce procurement.

Best,
Lisa
Lisa Grant
VP, Product Strategy | MedTech Co.
lisa.grant@medtechco.com

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Sponsor bridge: outcomes, risk matrix, and procurement checkpoints

Jonas / Ben —

Couple of internal notes and proposed playbook items before we go broader:
- Prep the SOW to emphasize a 6-week pilot with explicit acceptance criteria tied to p90 latency and cost baseline comparisons (include measurement plan + dashboards).
- Create a one-page security appendix summarizing SOC2 artifacts and KMS options (bring both hosted KMS + CMK flow). This reduces back-and-forth with Maria.
- Sales motion: request a sponsor 'decision guardrail' in the intro email (Dr. Patel — list the minimal criteria for pilot approval). Helps shorten legal loop.

I can draft the security appendix and the measurement plan. Ben will own the pricing sketch for the pilot (50% upfront credit for pilot ramp).

Also recommend we schedule the technical readiness session for Apr 20 at 2pm PST and tentatively invite Tony. If Lisa confirms, I’ll send the invite and agenda.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@medtechco.com>, Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@medtechco.com>, Tony Rhee <tony.rhee@medtechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Draft SOW, timeline, and technical readiness session (Apr 20)

Hi Lisa / Maria / Tony —

Thanks Lisa for the quick turnaround and for introducing Maria and Tony. Per our call and internal alignment, attached is the draft SOW and a procurement timeline we tailored to your typical review path. High level:
- Pilot: 6 weeks, read-only ingestion of synthetic notes, acceptance = p90 latency < 200ms and cost delta <= 50% vs current baseline.
- Security: SOC2 evidence package attached as an appendix; we propose a customer-managed KMS option (details in security appendix).
- Commercial: pilot pricing sketch included; we can convert pilot credit to committed Reserved capacity if metrics meet the guardrails.

Requesting next actions:
1) Maria — please confirm the list of security artifacts you need (if different from SOC2 + encryption details) and whether a short checklist in our SOW is sufficient for your intake.
2) Tony — can you confirm Apr 20 at 2:00 PM PST for the technical readiness session? We’ll share an agenda: EHR connector mapping (20m), test data plan (10m), integration checklist (10m).
3) Lisa / Dr. Patel — if you’re comfortable, please include the pilot acceptance criteria in your sponsor intro email to legal to accelerate the contract review window.

Attachments: redwood_sow_draft_v1.pdf, procurement_timeline_medtech.xlsx

I’ll update the SOW based on Maria’s feedback and send a version for signature when legal is ready.

Cheers,
Jonas
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
